events.text: `helper_test_op` floors forward error at `atol=1e-6`; my `compare_npz` uses `ATOL_F=1e-5` — ~40 float32 ulp at unit scale and untied to the operand magnitude, so a near-zero-output case can flap PASS/FWD_MISMATCH on a last-bit difference. Anchoring the forward floor to a few real ulp via `np.spacing` instead of the magic constant:

events.command: uv run python scratch/hunt/compare_npz.py O3-CPU scratch/hunt/out/cpu_default scratch/hunt/out/cpu_noopt 2>&1 | tail -1

events.text: O3-CPU still clean at 87/87 with the tighter floor — the forward gate is now `4·ulp(|operand|) + rtol·|ref|`, ~5e-7 at unit scale instead of a flat `1e-5`, so it tracks float32 precision rather than a hand-picked constant.
